policy: Shared DRK short-text classification, bounds and line-count optical centering; no per-card geometry. Identical reviewed original wording and frozen scan poses on both sides of every score. The 97 scored DRK references have been repeatedly inspected and are not independent validation. Five source-body corrections are isolated in their separate receipt. All 316 early printings render; non-DRK faces and every pixel outside body text stay exact. Oracle fitting is checked in all three alignment modes. Text indices are regional similarity, not percent correct or complete-set certification.
limitations: 34 early-set interior scan poses remain unscored, including 25 in DRK.

Residual font weight, activation symbol style, punctuation and regular-text wrapping remain open. Electric Eel and Fire Drake need activation punctuation review; Fissure needs quotation-style review. Brothers of Fire still wraps its first rule line differently; Drowned remains a regular-size outlier.
Frame-score regions overlap body text; no geometry gain is inferred from a changed whole-card aggregate.

visualReview.method: Raw cached scans beside corrected baseline and native 0.4.8; no scan normalization or scores inferred.
